name: Innocent Girl
source:
There are two types of artists: those who wish to portray something and those who wish to convey something. Wataru had given up on being either of them. Hiding his past, he planned to live a life unrelated to the arts. However, due to some family circumstances, he ended up transferring into the arts boarding school Kurisaki Academy. He shared a dormitory, “Dream house”, with four fellow students, who all have their own eccentricities: quiet classmate Kagari, reunited little sister-in-law Hinako, friendly childhood friend Konoka, and the beautiful semi-pro artist Kanae. His biggest secret was blown the first day of school. What will happen now as he has no interest in the arts at all?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/02/01/february-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
艺术家有两种：想描绘某种事物的人，以及想传达某种事物的人。航已经放弃成为其中任何一种。他隐瞒过去，原本打算过上与艺术毫无关系的生活。然而，由于家庭的缘故，他最终转入了艺术寄宿学校久里咲学园。他在“梦想庄”宿舍里，与四位各具古怪个性的学生同住：寡言的同班同学卡加莉、久别重逢的义妹雏子、亲切的青梅竹马科诺卡，以及美丽的半职业艺术家鼎。开学第一天，他最大的秘密就被揭穿了。对艺术毫无兴趣的他，接下来会怎么样呢？

（摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/02/01/february-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]）
